> We have a manual tests project for Console as a worst case; would this be caught there?

In theory yes, because after running each test the user is asked to press `y/n` and when pressing `y` the app was printing `121` instead of `y`:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6011991/158595632-47d4ea20-0333-4149-a6cd-8d2d9f2cdffc.png)

But to be 100% sure I've added a new test:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6011991/158595987-55305527-7e5e-4a29-a01f-f0b471384993.png)

> Any way to add a test? 

I currently don't have a better idea than extending the manual tests. I hope that when I get more familiar with `System.Console` I am going to be able to automate it.

It does repro for me (using dotnet/runtime build from 3/10). Here is the callstack where the write is coming from:
```
System_Console!Interop+Kernel32.WriteFile(IntPtr, Byte*, Int32, Int32 ByRef, IntPtr)+0xce [C:\runtime\src\libraries\System.Console\src\Microsoft.Interop.LibraryImportGenerator\Microsoft.Interop.LibraryImportGenerator\LibraryImports.g.cs @ 816] 
System_Console!System.ConsolePal+WindowsConsoleStream.WriteFileNative(IntPtr, System.ReadOnlySpan`1<Byte>, Boolean)+0x81 [C:\runtime\src\libraries\System.Console\src\System\ConsolePal.Windows.cs @ 1189] 
System_Console!System.ConsolePal+WindowsConsoleStream.Write(System.ReadOnlySpan`1<Byte>)+0x57 [C:\runtime\src\libraries\System.Console\src\System\ConsolePal.Windows.cs @ 1125] 
System_Private_CoreLib!System.IO.StreamWriter.Flush(Boolean, Boolean)+0x1d2
System_Private_CoreLib!System.IO.StreamWriter.Write(System.String)+0x188
System_Private_CoreLib!System.IO.TextWriter.Write(Int32)+0x36
System_Private_CoreLib!System.IO.TextWriter+SyncTextWriter.Write(Int32)+0x43
System_Console!System.Console.Write(Int32)+0x31 [C:\runtime\src\libraries\System.Console\src\System\Console.cs @ 910] 
System_Console!System.ConsolePal.ReadKey(Boolean)+0x309 [C:\runtime\src\libraries\System.Console\src\System\ConsolePal.Windows.cs @ 399] 
System_Console!System.Console.ReadKey()+0x19 [C:\runtime\src\libraries\System.Console\src\System\Console.cs @ 174] 
```
The problem was introduced by changing the type of `KeyEventRecord.uChar` from `char` to `ushort`. We are calling wrong `Write` overload now.
I can still repro this issue in .NET 7.0 Preview 2. I will retry when the PR is complete.
